panels.description: Number of queries in each execution phase at each auto-intervalute interval. Phase is determined by start_time + cumulative phase durations (queue → compile → planning → lock_wait → execution).

targets.rawSQL:
WITH RECURSIVE seq(n) AS (
  SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM seq WHERE n < 360
),
buckets AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + floor(extract(epoch from q_min) / ($__interval_ms/1000)) * ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second' + (n * ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second') AS bucket
  FROM seq, (SELECT min(start_time) AS q_min FROM sys_query_history WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time))
  WHERE TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + floor(extract(epoch from q_min) / ($__interval_ms/1000)) * ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second' + (n * ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= GETDATE()
),
phases AS (
  SELECT query_id, start_time AS t0,
    DATEADD(us, queue_time, start_time) AS t1,
    DATEADD(us, queue_time + compile_time, start_time) AS t2,
    DATEADD(us, queue_time + compile_time + planning_time, start_time) AS t3,
    DATEADD(us, queue_time + compile_time + planning_time + lock_wait_time, start_time) AS t4,
    COALESCE(end_time, GETDATE()) AS t5
  FROM sys_query_history
  WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
),
assigned AS (
  SELECT b.bucket, p.query_id,
    CASE
      WHEN b.bucket + ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second' <= p.t1 THEN 'queue'
      WHEN b.bucket + ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second' <= p.t2 THEN 'compile'
      WHEN b.bucket + ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second' <= p.t3 THEN 'planning'
      WHEN b.bucket + ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second' <= p.t4 THEN 'lock_wait'
      ELSE 'execution'
    END AS phase
  FROM buckets b
  JOIN phases p ON p.t0 < b.bucket + ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second' AND p.t5 >= b.bucket + ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second'
)
SELECT bucket AS time,
  count(CASE WHEN phase = 'queue' THEN 1 END) AS queue,
  count(CASE WHEN phase = 'compile' THEN 1 END) AS compile,
  count(CASE WHEN phase = 'planning' THEN 1 END) AS planning,
  count(CASE WHEN phase = 'lock_wait' THEN 1 END) AS lock_wait,
  count(CASE WHEN phase = 'execution' THEN 1 END) AS execution
FROM assigned
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.time, sum(t.cnt) OVER (ORDER BY t.time ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS started
FROM (

SELECT TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + floor(extract(epoch from end_time) / ($__interval_ms/1000)) * ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time,
  count(CASE WHEN trim(status) = 'failed' THEN 1 END) AS failed,
  count(CASE WHEN trim(status) = 'canceled' THEN 1 END) AS canceled,
  count(CASE WHEN trim(status) = 'success' THEN 1 END) AS success
FROM sys_query_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(end_time) AND status IN ('success','failed','canceled')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.time, sum(t.cnt) OVER (ORDER BY t.time ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS completed
FROM (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + floor(extract(epoch from end_time) / ($__interval_ms/1000)) * ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time, count(*) AS cnt
  FROM sys_query_history
  WHERE $__timeFilter(end_time) AND status IN ('success','failed','canceled')
  GROUP BY 1
) t ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.status, COALESCE(q.count, 0) as count FROM (
  SELECT 'planning' as status UNION ALL SELECT 'queued' UNION ALL SELECT 'running'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'returning' UNION ALL SELECT 'failed' UNION ALL SELECT 'canceled'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'success'
) s LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT trim(status) as status, count(*) as count FROM sys_query_history
  WHERE status IN ('planning','queued','running','returning')
     OR (status IN ('failed','canceled','success') AND $__timeFilter(start_time))
  GROUP BY 1
) q ON s.status = q.status
ORDER BY CASE s.status
  WHEN 'planning' THEN 1 WHEN 'queued' THEN 2 WHEN 'running' THEN 3
  WHEN 'returning' THEN 4 WHEN 'failed' THEN 5 WHEN 'canceled' THEN 6
  WHEN 'success' THEN 7 END

SELECT query_id, user_id, trim(status) as status, trim(query_type) as query_type, start_time, elapsed_time, queue_time, execution_time, returned_rows, trim(query_text) as query_text
FROM sys_query_history WHERE status NOT IN ('canceled', 'failed', 'success') ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT query_id, user_id, trim(status) as status, trim(query_type) as query_type, start_time, elapsed_time, queue_time, execution_time, returned_rows, trim(left(query_text, 100)) as query_text_short

SELECT TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + floor(extract(epoch from h.end_time) / ($__interval_ms/1000)) * ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time,

SELECT TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + floor(extract(epoch from commit_end_time) / ($__interval_ms/1000)) * ($__interval_ms/1000) * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time,

panels.description: Top tables by number of scans

targets.rawSQL:
-- grafana-redshift-default-dashboard
SELECT
    "time",
    CASE WHEN rnk <= 5 THEN rnk::text || ': ' || table_name ELSE 'other tables' END AS "table",
    sum(cnt) AS " "
FROM (
    SELECT
        "time",
        table_name,
        cnt,
        total,
        dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC, table_name) AS rnk
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            "time",
            table_name,
            cnt,
            sum(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY table_name) AS total
        FROM (
            SELECT
                $__timeGroup(s.endtime, $__interval),
                n.nspname || '.' || c.relname AS table_name,
                count(DISTINCT query) AS cnt
            FROM stl_scan AS s
            JOIN pg_class AS c ON c.oid = s.tbl
            JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
            WHERE
                s.type = 2 AND
                trim(perm_table_name) != 'Internal Worktable' AND
                perm_table_name NOT LIKE 'volt_tt_%' AND
                $__timeFilter(s.endtime)
            GROUP BY 1, 2
            ORDER BY 1, 2
        ) AS table_cnt
    ) AS table_cnt_total
) AS table_cnt_total_rnk
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER by 1, 2

panels.description: Query count grouped by processing time. The processing time doesn't include lock wait, and other pre- queuing steps.

targets.rawSQL:
-- grafana-redshift-default-dashboard
SELECT
    $__timeGroup(end_time, $__interval),
    sum(CASE WHEN total_time >= 1000000*60*60::bigint THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "1h+",
    sum(CASE WHEN total_time >= 1000000*10*60 AND total_time < 1000000*60*60::bigint THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "10m-1h",
    sum(CASE WHEN total_time >= 1000000*60 AND total_time < 1000000*10*60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "1m-10m",
    sum(CASE WHEN total_time >= 1000000*10 AND total_time < 1000000*60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "10s-1m",
    sum(CASE WHEN total_time < 1000000*10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "<10s",
    1.0 * (
        sum(CASE WHEN wlm_query IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
        nullif(sum(CASE WHEN query IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    ) AS result_cache_hit_pct,
    sum(aborted) AS incomplete_queries
FROM (
    SELECT 
        coalesce(service_class_end_time, endtime) AS end_time,
        datediff(
            microsecond, 
            coalesce(service_class_start_time, starttime), 
            coalesce(service_class_end_time, endtime)
        ) AS total_time,
        swq.query AS wlm_query,
        sq.query AS query,
        aborted
    FROM (
        SELECT * FROM stl_query
        WHERE userid != 1 AND $__timeFilter(endtime)
    ) AS sq
    FULL JOIN (
        SELECT * FROM stl_wlm_query
        WHERE service_class > 4 AND userid != 1 AND $__timeFilter(exec_end_time)
    ) AS swq ON 
        swq.query = sq.query
) AS s
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

    $__timeGroup(starttime, $__interval),
    sum(blocks_read) AS data_size_read,
    sum(rows) AS scaned_rows,
    count(DISTINCT query) AS writing_intermediate_to_disk
FROM (
    SELECT
        starttime,

        CASE WHEN segment = -1 AND step_type = -1 AND step = -1 AND blocks_read > 0 THEN blocks_read
        ELSE NULL END AS blocks_read,

        CASE WHEN segment > -1 AND step_type = 1 AND step > -1 AND rows > 0 THEN rows
        ELSE NULL END AS rows,

        CASE WHEN segment = -1 AND step_type = -1 AND step = -1 AND blocks_to_disk > 0 THEN query
        ELSE NULL END AS query
    FROM stl_query_metrics
    WHERE
        service_class > 4 AND
        $__timeFilter(starttime)
) AS s
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Number of queries in the queue by priority. This number doesn't include queries which started before and ended after the time window.

targets.rawSQL:
-- grafana-redshift-default-dashboard
SELECT 
    "time",
    CASE query_priority 
        WHEN 'Highest' THEN 5
        WHEN 'High'    THEN 4
        WHEN 'Normal'  THEN 3
        WHEN 'Low'     THEN 2
        WHEN 'Lowest'  THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END || ': ' || query_priority,
    cnt + CASE WHEN min_cnt > 0 THEN 0 ELSE -min_cnt END AS " "
FROM (
    SELECT 
        "time",
        query_priority,
        cnt,
        min(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY query_priority) AS min_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            "time",
            query_priority,
            sum(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY query_priority ORDER BY "time" ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cnt
        FROM (
            SELECT
                "time",
                coalesce(started_queuing.query_priority, ended_queuing.query_priority) AS query_priority,
                coalesce(started_queuing.cnt, 0) - coalesce(ended_queuing.cnt, 0) AS cnt
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    $__timeGroup(queue_start_time, $__interval),
                    query_priority,
                    count(1) AS cnt
                FROM stl_wlm_query
                WHERE $__timeFilter(queue_start_time)
                GROUP BY 1, 2
            ) AS started_queuing
            FULL JOIN (
                SELECT
                    $__timeGroup(queue_end_time, $__interval),
                    query_priority,
                    count(1) AS cnt
                FROM stl_wlm_query
                WHERE $__timeFilter(queue_end_time)
                GROUP BY 1, 2
            ) AS ended_queuing USING ("time", query_priority)
        ) AS cont_queued
    ) AS min_cont_queued
) AS adj_cont_queued
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: Number of queries being executed by priority. This number doesn't include queries which started before and ended after the time window.

targets.rawSQL:
-- grafana-redshift-default-dashboard
SELECT 
    "time",
    CASE query_priority 
        WHEN 'Highest' THEN 5
        WHEN 'High'    THEN 4
        WHEN 'Normal'  THEN 3
        WHEN 'Low'     THEN 2
        WHEN 'Lowest'  THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END || ': ' || query_priority,
    cnt + CASE WHEN min_cnt > 0 THEN 0 ELSE -min_cnt END AS " "
FROM (
    SELECT 
        "time",
        query_priority,
        cnt,
        min(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY query_priority) AS min_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            "time",
            query_priority,
            sum(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY query_priority ORDER BY "time" ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cnt
        FROM (
            SELECT
                "time",
                coalesce(started_executing.query_priority, ended_executing.query_priority) AS query_priority,
                coalesce(started_executing.cnt, 0) - coalesce(ended_executing.cnt, 0) AS cnt
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    $__timeGroup(exec_start_time, $__interval),
                    query_priority,
                    count(1) AS cnt
                FROM stl_wlm_query
                WHERE $__timeFilter(exec_start_time)
                GROUP BY 1, 2
            ) AS started_executing
            FULL JOIN (
                SELECT
                    $__timeGroup(exec_end_time, $__interval),
                    query_priority,
                    count(1) AS cnt
                FROM stl_wlm_query
                WHERE $__timeFilter(exec_end_time)
                GROUP BY 1, 2
            ) AS ended_executing USING ("time", query_priority)
        ) AS cont_executed
    ) AS min_cont_executed
) AS adj_cont_executed
ORDER BY 1

    1.0*sum(CASE WHEN concurrency_scaling_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(1) AS " "
FROM stl_wlm_query
JOIN stl_query USING (query)
JOIN stv_wlm_service_class_config USING (service_class)
WHERE
    service_class > 4 AND
    $__timeFilter(exec_end_time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
